SELECT DISTINCT g.* FROM games g
INNER JOIN game_categories gc ON g.id = gc.game_id
WHERE g.status = 1
AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.developer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.publisher LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND gc.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND COALESCE(g.discount_price, g.original_price) >= #{minPrice}
AND COALESCE(g.discount_price, g.original_price) <= #{maxPrice}
AND g.discount_percent > 0
AND g.is_featured = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(g.discount_price, g.original_price)
ORDER BY g.rating
ORDER BY g.sales_count
ORDER BY g.release_date
ORDER BY g.created_at
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
